title: Hegseth “ignores” stockpile problem
summary: The U.S. missile stockpile is at critical depletion levels, however Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth maintains there are “massive amounts” of munitions left to continue fighting in the Middle East. Jessica Tarlov and Ryan Grim discuss, on Raging Moderates.

Senior US military leaders in the Army, Navy, and Air Force Chiefs have warned Pete Hegseth that sustaining current operations against Iran is infeasible long-term. We know that the stockpiles are dwindling, and I'm being generous and just using dwindling as the term. How is Hegseth ignoring all of this? >> Our raw soft power is enough such that when our presidents speak, it moves entire nations. And so, we have lost touch with the idea that underneath that there is a material reality. Like these

things cost millions of dollars a piece, they take years to produce, and we're running out of them. These are just facts.
